title: Automated Enforcement and Traffic Safety
eligible_reason: Binary absorbing treatment (camera installed at an intersection; new_post for advanced cameras, old_post for conventional) switching on at intersection-specific installation months (about 50 distinct installation months for advanced-only cameras and 18 for conventional per the Appendix B timeline code), with never-treated intersections as controls, on a 36-month intersection panel. The paper reports Callaway-Sant'Anna (csdid2, not-yet-treated, simple aggregate) alongside every TWFE column of Tables 2 and 4, and Borusyak-Jaravel-Spiess (did_imputation) and de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille (did_multiplegt) event studies in Figure 2. The TWFE columns themselves include time-varying intersection controls and are ineligible; eligibility rests on the modern-estimator reports (dCDH has no controls; CSA and BJS use Jan-2014 time-constant controls plus one time-varying policy dummy ban_post - flagged).
design_notes: Stata 18 (reghdfe, csdid2, did_imputation, did_multiplegt, eventstudyinteract, event_plot). DataClean.do builds traffic_data.dta from proprietary traffic_rawdata.dta: unit crossid, time yearmonth -> ym_id; its/old/new = any/conventional/advanced camera; `v'_post = (`v'_cum!=0); `v'_st installation yearmonth; `v'_stid month index (0 if never) used as csdid gvar; event dummies bef13m..aft13m; outcomes log(count+1). Main samples: advanced = 138 advanced-only intersections + 574 never-camera intersections (its_treat==0 & its_aft2016==1) = 712; conventional = 765 + 574 = 1,339; 36 months. Logs (Results_MainText.log etc.) contain full output, so published TWFE, CSA, SA, BJS estimates are recoverable. Controls lgctrlvar vary monthly (they have estimated coefficients in the within regressions); tcctrlvar fixes them at Jan 2014 but keeps ban_post.
estimators_reported: callaway_santanna (csdid2, notyet, agg simple, method reg)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: From Results_AppendixB.log (Figure B-5 code): merges of installation-month counts matched 50 distinct year-months for new-only cameras and 18 for conventional cameras (2,522 intersections total: 958 never any camera, 574 camera only after 2016, 765 conventional only, 138 advanced only, 87 both). Exact cohort sizes not recoverable without data.
always_treated_note: BJS specs drop always-treated units via `c'_st>201400; csdid2 reports 'Always Treated units have been excluded'.
